result.summary: The page is generally polished and functional-looking, with only minor layout concerns related to horizontally clipped content and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and the third 'Fastest near you' restaurant card are visibly cut off at the viewport edge, including the restaurant title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional overflow behavior, visible scroll affordance, and sufficient end padding; truncate card titles with an ellipsis where needed.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation cuts across the lower portion of the next restaurant card, leaving its image/content partially hidden in the current viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable page content equal to the navigation bar height so cards can be fully viewed without being obscured.
